name: beril-theme
description: Page frame for the BERIL Knowledge Wiki: record header, evidence rail, topic map.

scripts.build: npm run build:client && esbuild src/index.ts src/frames.tsx src/components.tsx --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node22 --external:preact --external:preact/* --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=preact --loader:.txt=text --outdir=dist && npm run build:search

quartz.name: beril-theme
quartz.description: Record-card page frame with an evidence rail and a topic map.

BerilClient.name: BerilClient
BerilClient.description: Section search, the CBORG key dialog, Ask and the collection toolbars.
